finding.summary: Non-dry-run execution now hard-fails (sys.exit(1)) if .env is missing. Previously load_dotenv() silently did nothing when .env was absent, allowing deployments that set environment variables directly (without a .env file) to work. This breaks those deployments.
finding.fix: Make .env optional: remove the hard exit on missing .env, and only error later if a required env var is still unset after load_dotenv. This preserves backward compatibility for deployments that inject env vars externally while still surfacing clear errors when credentials are genuinely missing.

label: false_positive
label_reason: a missing `.env` stopping a real run is the behaviour PMAT-231 requires ("Clear error if the `.env` file is missing"), covered by `test_missing_file_exits_naming_the_path`; no caller or CI runs the agent without a `.env`.
